programAuthorityApproval.level: Level E (narrow operational read-only inspection only)
scope: D16 historical inventory and collision assessment
authorizedActivities: Read-only inspection of the existing database
Inventory of existing portfolio and ownership records
Counts of relevant records and relationships
Identification of duplicate identifiers, collisions, NULL relationships and orphan records
Inspection of existing migration ledger state without executing migrations
Collection of evidence concerning historical ownership and provenance
Documentation of unknown or ambiguous records without assigning inferred ownership
absoluteProhibitions: Application startup if it could invoke the migration runner

reasonsDisqualified: Calls openDatabase() in src/persistence/connection.ts, which executes mkdirSync, opens new DatabaseSync(filePath) in read-write/create mode (creating an empty SQLite file if absent), and issues PRAGMA journal_mode = DELETE and PRAGMA synchronous = FULL.

Calls ensureMigrations(db, GATE3_MIGRATIONS) in src/persistence/migration_ledger.ts, which executes CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS _migration_ledger and applies pending migrations 001..006 inside BEGIN IMMEDIATE ... COMMIT.
Constructs ClassPJournal in src/ipc/entrypoint.ts, creating/writing ipc-diagnostics on disk.
CLI entrypoint sets IIPS_LOCAL_PERSONAL_USE=1 and binds the IPC listener.
Executes BEGIN IMMEDIATE ... COMMIT, requiring a SQLite write lock.
Uses gateAPrimeValidation.ts GATE3_MIGRATIONS (001..004 only), failing DP-V1 and DP-V2 on databases migrated through 005_holding_security_identity and 006_portfolio_restore.
Does not refuse active -wal/-shm/-journal sidecars before open and does not emit the required D16 portfolio/holding/contribution/restore-receipt/collision/orphan/NULL-relationship inventory.

confirmedReadOnlyInspectionMethod.driver: node:sqlite DatabaseSync(dbPath, { open: true, readOnly: true })
preOpenChecks: Verify no IPD/IRR process holds the database open.
Refuse immediately if <db>-wal, <db>-shm, or <db>-journal sidecar files exist.
Verify via fs.lstatSync that target exists, is a regular file (not symlink/directory), size >= 100 bytes, and starts with 16-byte header 'SQLite format 3\0'.
Compute pre-open sizeBytes, mtimeIso, and full-file SHA-256.
confirmedReadOnlyInspectionMethod.snapshotWrapper: BEGIN DEFERRED; ... SELECT / read-only PRAGMA queries Q01..Q14 only ... ROLLBACK;
postCloseChecks: Confirm zero -wal, -shm, or -journal sidecar files exist.
Recompute sizeBytes, mtimeIso, and full-file SHA-256 and require exact byte-for-byte equality with pre-open values.

inventoryOutcome.blockerSummary: The designated local SQLite database (C:\iips-data\iips\user-portfolio.sqlite) resides on the Principal's local Windows host and does not exist in, and is unreachable from, the Arena Linux x86_64 sandbox. Safe execution stopped without creating, seeding, migrating or modifying any database.

It is not direct SQLite table evidence and is not substituted here.
